repository.license: No license file declared in the pinned GitHub archive

notes: SpotSound-Bench provides ready-to-use audio and annotations.
The complete 77.6k training corpus and exact validation split are not released.
No official batch evaluator or prediction file is released.
The author Space releases the compatible parser and inference path used by this audit.

compute_fit.estimate: Checkpoint evaluation fits one 32GB vGPU; observed peak 16.4GB on five samples.

research_headroom.assessment: High diagnostic headroom in fine-grained boundaries and multi-event interval sets.

decision_reason: Official checkpoint and public benchmark are runnable; missing evaluator prevents an unqualified one-click reproduction claim.
